whenToUse: Editing what a role or plan may do: resources × actions with checkboxes or scopes.
Admin role editors and plan feature toggles.
avoidWhen: Assigning roles to users — use Data Table with Select.
A handful of yes/no settings — use Switch rows.
a11y: A real grid with row and column headers; each cell control names resource and action.
Scope levels are announced by name, not fill level.
